title: Would love recommendation's for films you love or found weird or interesting.

commenti.body:
Apart from Past Lives, that's a very stressful lineup! Burning and Titane will fit right in.

If you are ever in the mood for something more lighthearted, I'd suggest going for Obayashi, either House or His Motorbike, Her Island. The Taste of Tea is also a good one.

If you want to go on with the stressful ones, Park Chan-woo's work seems like a good fit. The Vengeance trilogy is a good start.
Yes we tend to lean into that stressful movie box but also love lighthearted thanks for the suggestion.
